description: Every component page, by package, with what each is for in a line. Pass a package to see only its pages.

package.description: A package, such as @nuvui/table or table. One of: @nuvui/react, @nuvui/date-picker, @nuvui/table, @nuvui/charts, @nuvui/barcodes, @nuvui/chat, @nuvui/kanban, @nuvui/editor, @nuvui/emoji, @nuvui/map, @nuvui/flow, @nuvui/media, @nuvui/backgrounds, @nuvui/3d, @nuvui/icons.

version.description: The @nuvui/react version in the project's package.json, such as 0.6.2 or ^0.6.0, for the docs of that release. Leave it out for the latest release.

name: list_components
